record.paper_title: The Li–Lin’s open problem on R^N
record.original_question: For an integer N ≥ 3, let Ω be a smooth bounded domain in R^N and let 0 < s < 2. With Hardy–Sobolev critical exponent 2*(s) = 2(N − s)/(N − 2), and with exponent p satisfying 2*(s) − 1 < p < (N + 2)/(N − 2), does the Dirichlet elliptic problem Δu − u^p + u^(2*(s)−1)/|x|^s = 0 in Ω, with u = 0 on ∂Ω, admit positive solutions?

evidence.quote: Consider the following nonlinear equation involving Hardy-Sobolev exponents: { −∆u = −λ|x|−s1 |u|p−2u + |x|−s2 |u|q−2u in Ω, u(x) = 0 on ∂Ω, (1.1) where ∆ denotes the standard Laplace operator, Ω is a smooth bounded domain in RN (N ≥ 3), λ ∈ R, 0 ≤ s1 < s2 < 2, 2∗(s) = 2(N − s)/(N − 2) for 0 ≤ s ≤ 2, 2 < p ≤ 2∗(s1), and 2 < q ≤ 2∗(s2).
Specifically, for the equation ∆u − up + u2∗(s)−1/|x|s = 0 in Ω, where 0 < s < 2 and 2∗(s) − 1 < p < (N + 2)/(N − 2), the existence of positive solutions remains an interesting open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N \geq 3$ be an integer, let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ be a smooth bounded domain (with $0 \in \overline{\Omega}$ assumed so that the Hardy–Sobolev weight $|x|^{-s}$ is meaningful), and let $s \in (0,2)$. Define the Hardy–Sobolev critical exponent $2^*(s) := \dfrac{2(N-s)}{N-2}$. Let $p$ satisfy $2^*(s) - 1 < p < \dfrac{N+2}{N-2}$. Determine whether the Dirichlet boundary-value problem
$$\Delta u - u^p + \dfrac{u^{\,2^*(s)-1}}{|x|^s} \;=\; 0 \quad \text{in } \Omega, \qquad u = 0 \ \text{on } \partial \Omega,$$
admits a positive (classical) solution $u \in C^2(\Omega) \cap C(\overline{\Omega})$ with $u > 0$ in $\Omega$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is described as an open existence question for a Hardy–Sobolev-type elliptic equation on bounded domains, in the regime where the subcritical perturbation $-u^p$ has exponent $p$ between the Hardy–Sobolev critical exponent and the Sobolev critical exponent. No published resolution was located; recent work continues to treat it as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: The Li–Lin's open problem on R^N (arXiv:2505.03613)
status_evidence.snippet: The existence of positive solutions to the bounded-domain Hardy–Sobolev equation Δu − u^p + u^{2*(s)−1}/|x|^s = 0 in Ω with u=0 on ∂Ω remains an open problem in the indicated parameter range.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of positive solutions for this bounded-domain Hardy–Sobolev Dirichlet problem in the range 2*(s)−1 < p < (N+2)/(N−2) is stated to remain open.
